Simple Roasted Tomateos
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Thursday, October 1, 2015 - 7:34am

Ingredients




Box of farm fresh tomatoes
Head of fresh garlic
Olive oil
Salt & pepper
Italian Seasoning

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350º F 2 Get a RIMMED baking dish 3 Wash tomatoes and cut into 1/2 or 1/4 depending on the size 4 Place in baking dish (DO NOT crowd) 5 Generously coat with olive oil 6 Add slices of fresh garlic 7 Season with salt and pepper 8 Add 1 tsp. Italian seasoning (optional) 9 Roast for 2 hours....stirring several times during roasting 10 Cool 11 Place desired amount into freezer bags. ENJOY!!

About

Reap the rewards of a bountiful harvest and savour the flavour of Simple Roasted Tomatoes.  Intense, robust flavour with little effort.  Simple is best!!
